name: tasks
description: Team tasks with title, assignee, due date and completion status. For people and agents.

requiredTables.name: tasks
requiredTables.description: Team tasks: title, assignee, due date, completed yes/no, creator and timestamps.

offeredTools.name: tasks.list
offeredTools.description: Lists tasks: open ones first, then by due date (tasks without a date last), then newest. Arguments, all optional: completed (true/false, only completed or only open tasks), assignee (name of the person, case-insensitive, exact match), limit (1 to 200, default 50). Returns { tasks: [{ id, title, assignee, dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD or null), completed, completedAt, completedBy, createdBy, createdAt }] }. You need the id for tasks.complete.

offeredTools.name: tasks.create
offeredTools.description: Creates an open task. Arguments: title (required, 1 to 200 characters), assignee (required, name of the person responsible), dueDate (optional, YYYY-MM-DD). The caller is stored as createdBy. Returns { task } with the new id. Check with tasks.list first whether the task already exists.

offeredTools.name: tasks.complete
offeredTools.description: Marks a task as completed and records who completed it and when. Argument: id (UUID from tasks.list). If it is already completed, nothing changes (changed: false). An unknown id returns 404. Returns { task, changed }.

requestedGrants.reason: Who may open the app. Which group is decided by the grant in the control plane — a requested right is an application, not a grant.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Connection to the app's own schema, with the app role. Set by the control plane.

env.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
env.description: The app's own schema. The SDK derives the search_path from it; a DSN with options= is rejected.

env.name: OPENAPPS_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: The app's own secret, used by the SDK to verify the gateway signature. Set by the control plane per deployment.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_ID
env.description: Id of this app in the signature material. Must match byte-for-byte what the gateway writes.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_HOST
env.description: Shared domain in the signature material, trimmed and lowercased.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_BASE_PATH
env.description: Path the app lives under (/tasks). Must be set at build time, otherwise links and images point nowhere.
